description: Will this Hugging Face repo run on this hardware? Checks the repo and its quantized derivatives (GGUF/MLX/AWQ...) and returns, per candidate: verdict (fits | fits-tight | offload | no | unknown), memory placement (VRAM / RAM / SSD), longest context that fits, decode and prefill tok/s bands with basis, concurrent-serving aggregate, runtime support (llama.cpp / vLLM / MLX registries) and an exact launch command. repo: 'org/name' (base model or a GGUF repo). hardware: preset id, '<N>x-<id>', free text, or 'gpu=..,ram=..,bw=..'; pass the usable memory the user states: 'jetson-thor,usable=117'. ctx in tokens. When nothing is recommended, memory_check lists each quant's need in GiB and whether it fits in memory. If the repo is not on the Hub the result is error 'model_not_found' with a message and no estimate. model.license and model.native_ctx (the model's own context limit) come with it. variant: only this quant, e.g. 'Q8_0' (default: the best for the device). response_format: leave unset; the default has every decision field in <2k tokens. 'detailed' adds only the best candidate's files, notes and source URLs.
name: estimate_fit
title: Estimate model fit and speed
